subject: [PATCH v6 08/12] mm, swap: only charge physical swap entries

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch modifies how swap entries are charged against a memory control group (memcg). Instead of charging memcg->swap when a virtual swap entry is allocated, it charges only when the entry acquires physical backing. This change affects what the counter means and when the charge can fail, allowing for more accurate accounting and reclaiming of anon memory even with memory.swap.max set to 0 if zswap is allowed. The patch also refactors the swap memcg operations into separate helpers for getting, recording, charging, uncharging, and putting the owner.
